#### Load data
```{r load data}

# Kracht et al 2020 microglia
seurat_MG <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/Kracht_primary_microglia_seurat.rds")

# Microglai from coculture
seurat <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/microglia_d3_d15_d30_d58_integrated.rds")

# Subset only microglia cells, like for the pseudotime analysis
seurat_mg <- subset(seurat, subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)

# Subset only day 30 microglia cells
seurat_mg_d30 <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("MG-d30-cocul", "MG-d30-ctrl")) %>%
        subset(subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)

# Subset only day 30 cocultured microglia cells
seurat_mg_d30_cocul <- subset(seurat_mg_d30, subset = condition %in% c("COCUL")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)

# subset only clear microglia cells from the kracht dataset - exclude erythrocyte, monocyte, perivascular macrophage and sox-hi microglia
seurat_MG_only <- subset(seurat_MG, subset = celltype %in% c("Homeostatic microglia (early)", "Homeostatic microglia (late)", "Activated microglia", "Proliferating microglia", "SOX-medium microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) 

## logCP10k-primary vs. logUMInorm-organoid
```

# Differential expression analysis between conditions

#### Basic DE analysis
```{r general similarity}

# General transcriptomic similarity between co-cultured vs 2D stem cell-derived microglia
Idents(seurat_mg) <- "sample"

avg_expr_sample <- sapply(sort(unique(seurat_mg$sample)), function(sample)
rowMeans(seurat_mg@assays$RNA@data[,which(seurat_mg$sample == sample)]))
colnames(avg_expr_sample) <- c("MG-d3-ctrl","MG-d15-ctrl","MG-d30-ctrl","MG-d58-ctrl", "MG-d3-cocul","MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul","MG-d58-cocul")
corr_sample <- cor(avg_expr_sample[VariableFeatures(seurat_mg),])
corr_sample
plot(hclust(as.dist(1-corr_sample)))
table(seurat_mg$sample)

```

#### Perform wicoxon test on in vitro microglia day 30
```{r perform wicoxon test on in vitro microglia day 30}

# Run wilcoxon test
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg <- wilcoxauc(seurat_mg_d30, group_by = "condition") %>%
  filter(group == "COCUL") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA))

# Many padj values equal 0, meaning that they go to infinity as -log10(padj) and cannot be plotted.
# The reason is that wilcoaux function rounds extremely small values to 0.
# To circumvent this is issue, we can change the 0 p-values (or p-adjusted values) to take the minimum value detected.
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg$padj[DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg$padj[which(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg$padj != 0)])

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           logFC < -log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg) 

# Remove mitochondria and ribosomal protein coding genes from the DE genes
blacklist <- c(grep("^MT-", DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg$feature, value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
diff_genes <- setdiff(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg$feature,blacklist)
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg %>% filter(feature %in% diff_genes)
nrow(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg)

write.csv(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/DE_day30_cocul_vs_ctrl.csv")

# plot
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/volcano_DE_day30_cocul_vs_ctrl.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=factor(outcome)), position = "jitter") +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 70) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.5), log(1.5), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(1), linetype="dotted") +
  ylim(0,330) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))
dev.off()


# Now plot marking genes of interest only
# Choose genes looking at the top different ones
filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg, outcome == "Up-regulated" & logFC > log(1.6))
filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg, outcome == "Down-regulated" & logFC < -log(1.6))

# Make a vector of chosen genes
de_markers_cocul <- c("RGS1", "ATF3", "HES1", "EEF1A1", "EGR1", "SAT1", "CCL3", "CCL4", "CCL3L1", "CCL4L2", "DUSP1", "ARL4C", "FABP5", "FGL2", "APOE", "IL1B", "HSP90B1", # upregulated
                                                                       "CCL2", "CCL13", "MMP9", "ANXA2", "S100A10", "CYP1B1", "F13A1", "HLA-DRA", "MRC1", "FTH", "CD163",  "PLAUR", "CD74", "SMIM4", "F13A1", "ANKRD12", "VSIG4", "HCST"  # downregulated
                                                                       )

# Filter them from the data frame
de_markers_cocul_order <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg %>% filter(feature %in% de_markers_cocul)

# Plot
plot <- ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=factor(outcome)), position = "jitter") +
  #geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 70) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.5), log(1.5), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(1), linetype="dotted") +
  ylim(0,330) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))

# Add labels
plot <- plot +
  geom_label_repel(data = de_markers_cocul_order, mapping = aes(logFC, -log10(padj), label = feature), size = 3, max.overlaps = 70) #+
  #geom_point(data = DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg %>% filter(feature %in% de_markers_cocul), color = "yellow")
```

```{r DESeq2}

######## DESeq2 took a long tiem to compute but the results did not differ majorly from Wilcoxon

library(DESeq2)
library(scran)
library(ggrepel)

det_rate <- rowMeans(seurat_mg_d30@assays$RNA@data)
meta <- seurat_mg_d30@meta.data %>% mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels=c("CTRL","COCUL")))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(seurat_mg_d30@assays$RNA@counts[det_rate > 0.05,],
                              colData=meta,
                              design = ~ condition)
sizeFactors(dds) <- calculateSumFactors(seurat_mg_d30@assays$RNA@counts[det_rate > 0.05,])
dds <- DESeq(dds, test="LRT", reduced=~1, useT=TRUE, minmu=1e-6, minReplicatesForReplace=Inf)
DE_deseq2_mg <- results(dds) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(log2FoldChange)>log2(1.1) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange)>log2(1.1) & padj < 0.01, gene, NA))

ggplot(DE_deseq2_mg, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), col=DE, label=DEG)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log2(1.1), log2(1.1), 0), col="#303030", linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), col="#303030", linetype="dotted") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#909090", "red")) +
  theme_minimal()

```

#### Advanced DE analysis

```{r DE advanced}

# all co-culture microglia, without the other cell types
idx_invitro <- which(! seurat$celltype %in% c("Smooth muscle cell","Neuron") & seurat$condition == "COCUL")
# subset only genes which are detected in either of the data sets
detection_rates_invitro <- rowMeans(seurat@assays$RNA@data[,idx_invitro] > 0)
detection_rates_invivo <- rowMeans(seurat_MG_only@assays$RNA@data > 0)
# generate a vector with overlapping genes in vitro (co-culture) and in vivo
shared_genes <- intersect(union(names(which(detection_rates_invitro > 0.01)), names(which(detection_rates_invivo > 0.01))), intersect(names(detection_rates_invitro),names(detection_rates_invivo)))
# generate a common matrix which contains the shared genes as rows and cocultured cells as columns; add the primary data with shared genes as rows and all cells as columns; the result is a matrix with shared genes as rows and cells from both conditions as columns
det_mat <- cbind(seurat@assays$RNA@data[shared_genes,idx_invitro] > 0, seurat_MG_only@assays$RNA@data[shared_genes,] > 0)
cond <- factor(rep(c("invitro","invivo"), c(length(idx_invitro),ncol(seurat_MG_only))))
# Generate a vector with the coverage info (.i.e number of genes or nFeature_RNA) of all cells
coverage <- c(seurat$nFeature_RNA[idx_invitro], seurat_MG_only$nFeature_RNA)
# Binarize the similarity values
bincounts <- seurat@assays$RNA@data > 0
sim2_MG_niches_bin <- ref_sim_spectrum(bincounts, avg_binexpr_niches[vargenes_niches,], scale=F)
dimnames(sim2_MG_niches_bin) <- list(colnames(seurat), colnames(avg_binexpr_niches))

ct <- factor(c(as.character(meta_niches$celltype[apply(sim2_MG_niches_bin,1,which.max)[idx_invitro]]),
               as.character(seurat_MG_only$celltype)),
```

```{r}
# coculture-duration-related expression changes
idx_invitro <- which(! seurat$celltype %in% c("Smooth muscle cell","Neuron") & seurat$condition == "COCUL")
detection_rates_invitro <- rowMeans(seurat@assays$RNA@data[,idx_invitro] > 0)
gene_cands <- names(which(detection_rates_invitro>0))

DE_cocul_duration <- ancova_group_test(expr = seurat@assays$RNA@data[gene_cands,idx_invitro],
                                       group = as.numeric(gsub("D","",seurat$timepoint[idx_invitro])),
                                       covar = data.frame(coverage = log(seurat$nCount_RNA[idx_invitro]), ct=seurat$celltype[idx_invitro],row.names=colnames(seurat)[idx_invitro]),
                                       num_threads = 50)
DE_cocul_duration_noct <- ancova_group_test(expr = seurat@assays$RNA@data[gene_cands,idx_invitro],
                                            group = as.numeric(gsub("D","",seurat$timepoint[idx_invitro])),
                                            covar = data.frame(coverage = log(seurat$nCount_RNA[idx_invitro]), row.names=colnames(seurat)[idx_invitro]),
                                            num_threads = 50)
DEG_cocult <- setdiff(rownames(DE_cocul_duration_noct)[which(p.adjust(DE_cocul_duration_noct$p_ANOVA, method="bonferroni")<0.01)], blacklist)

```
